title: Finish RA daemon cutover quarantine and legacy removal
description: Follow-on work after the daemon cutover: internalize daemon-only surfaces, migrate remaining legacy eager-runtime tests/tools, and remove the last public direct-runtime escape hatches.
design: Supported query execution must remain daemon-backed only. Legacy eager runtime stays explicitly quarantined until all remaining internal users are migrated or deleted.
acceptance_criteria: Remaining public/product surfaces no longer expose direct runtime execution; legacy runtime lives behind an explicit internal namespace/module only; remaining legacy tests and harnesses are either migrated or intentionally isolated with an explicit removal path.

title: Internalize WorkspaceService behind the daemon boundary
description: Stop re-exporting WorkspaceService from raql-host-ra at the public crate root. Make the daemon own the supported service boundary and move any remaining test access behind explicit internal test helpers.

title: Move LegacyRaHostRuntime into a dedicated legacy module
description: Pull the eager snapshot runtime out of raql-host-ra/src/lib.rs into an explicit legacy module/file so the quarantined path is structurally separate from supported daemon/runtime code.

title: Migrate repo smoke and corpus coverage onto the supported runtime
description: Move crates/raql-host-ra/tests/repo_smoke.rs and crates/raql-host-ra/tests/conformance_corpus.rs off the eager direct runtime so smoke/corpus validation exercises the daemon-backed incremental path.

title: Split workspace_init into supported-path and legacy-only suites
description: Break crates/raql-host-ra/tests/workspace_init.rs into daemon/runtime-service coverage for supported behavior and a clearly isolated legacy suite for any temporary direct-runtime assertions.

title: Migrate extern_runtime_dispatch tests off the eager legacy runtime
description: Replace direct eager-runtime coverage in crates/raql-host-ra/tests/extern_runtime_dispatch.rs with supported daemon/runtime-service coverage, or delete assertions that only exist to exercise the quarantined path.

title: Delete the direct-runtime CLI dev path once migrations are complete
description: Remove the remaining eager direct-runtime entrypoint from raql-cli after the last internal tests and bring-up flows stop depending on it. Supported query execution must remain daemon-only.

title: Restore RA-backed stdlib primitive families
description: Rebuild the remaining stdlib extern surface on top of the daemon-backed incremental rust-analyzer runtime, with explicit capability registration and supported-path regression coverage.
design: Keep std.raql source-stable; add provider families under stable extern names; no public fallback to legacy eager snapshot behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Each restored stdlib extern family is served by the supported daemon/runtime path, registered in capability gating, and covered by daemon-path tests.
